note: Domestic support announced for the Rasuwa–Bhotekoshi flood, as the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers lists it on its rescue portal (rescue.opmcm.gov.np/donations, 'Domestic support'). Copied verbatim from the Office's list (kept raw in reference/opmcm-domestic-support-2026-09-17.json); where the Office writes 'Rs', the portal writes 'NPR', figures untouched. Nothing here is added to a total: a pledge counts only once it appears in the Fund's own records. `state` says where each entry stands — pledged, already in the handover register (`register_ref` is the serial number there), or a disbursement out of the Fund shown under fund usage. Add later announcements here, in the same shape.
